subject: Security re-attestation, evidence cadence & capacity onramp
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@octavehealth.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@octavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Security re-attestation, evidence cadence & capacity onramp

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the renewal signal this morning. Per our discussion, I put together a concrete proposal for the SOC 2 re-attestation window, evidence delivery cadence, and the capacity uplift you asked about. High level: we can support a 24-month renewal with a 45-day attestation window, staged evidence delivery, and an onramp to add 2x dedicated inference capacity for a three-month burst.

What I am proposing for Octave Health:
- Evidence cadence: weekly bundles for the first 8 weeks (compressed handoff), then monthly snapshots for the remainder of the attestation period. Weekly bundles will include: control mappings, configuration exports, and a timestamped audit-snapshot (forensic-log excerpt).
- Retention: we will extend your audit log retention from 90 days to 365 days for the renewal period (we'll add a retention carveout in the SOW).
- Capacity onramp: dedicated pool increase from 4 -> 12 vGPU-equivalent units for a 90-day window (to cover peak processing during evidence ingest and re-eval runs).
- Commercials: for the above we can offer a one-time renewal credit of 8% on the next invoice and a custom term amendment to the MSA (24 months, with the retention addendum).

I've attached a light evidence manifest and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with dates. Can you confirm:
1) That the 365-day retention satisfies your auditors, or do they require a longer window?
2) Whether procurement needs a separate SOW or if the term amendment + credit is sufficient?
3) Any preferred blackout dates for the 90-day onramp window?

If useful, we can run a short technical dry-run next week to validate log exports and the forensic snapshot process. Thanks — I want to keep the attestation low-friction.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence_manifest_for_octave_v1.pdf (pdf), map_octave_renewal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Claire D'Souza <claire@octavehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@octavehealth.com>, Alex Liao <alex.liao@octavehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security re-attestation, evidence cadence & capacity onramp

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side (auditors + procurement):

1) Retention: our external auditor is comfortable with 365 days for most controls, but they will flag a few specific forensic traces if we cannot provide 2-year access. Can you confirm whether we can escrow a subset (redacted) for 24 months, or provide an export format that we could store?

2) Evidence format: are the weekly bundles in CSV + JSON schema? Our compliance team prefers structured CSV extracts for log ingestion.

3) Capacity & blackout windows: we have a product launch between Nov 15–22 which is a no-change window. Can the onramp start after Nov 30?

4) Procurement: they asked for an SOW with explicit acceptance criteria for the evidence handoff (timestamped hashes, sample files, and handoff checklist).

If you can share the exact export schema and confirm escrow options, procurement can draft the SOW quickly. Thanks — we want to avoid last-minute auditor questions.

Best,
Claire
Head of Security & Privacy, Octave Health
claire@octavehealth.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-24T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Security re-attestation, evidence cadence & capacity onramp — Octave follow-up

Team — forwarding Claire's questions. Key asks: 24-month escrow for a subset of forensic traces, confirmation of CSV+JSON export schema, and SOW with acceptance criteria. Procurement wants signed SOW; customer requests no onramp during Nov 15–22 and prefers onramp after Nov 30.

Proposed internal plan (quick):
- Technical: Provide a scoped escrow export (redacted PII) that lives in their AWS bucket for 24 months. Format = gzipped CSV for bulk logs + JSON manifest with SHA256 hashes. Our infra can produce this via the export job; estimated engineering effort: 2 dev-days to add the manifest & encryption wrapper.
- Capacity: approve onramp start window Dec 1 — implement 4 -> 12 vGPU-equivalent for 90 days. Pricing: keep core renewal at list, but allocate an 8% one-time credit for plank renewal value to cover retention uplift and engineering effort.
- Contract: have Legal prepare a 1‑page addendum (retention carveout + acceptance checklist) and Procurement team to append SOW referencing the MAP.

Questions for you: can we absorb the two dev-days from our infra SLX allocation, or do we need to price it explicitly? Ben, is the 8% credit within our approval limits or do we need a manager sign-off? Kim, once Legal has a draft, can you shepherd procurement?

Thanks — want to lock this by Oct 29 to keep timelines tight.

Hannah

>

Cc: procurement <procurement@octavehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security re-attestation, evidence cadence & capacity onramp

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We validated feasibility with infra and Legal this morning — summary and next steps below.

Confirmed items:
- Escrow subset: yes. We will provide a redacted, hashed forensic export packaged as gzipped CSV + a JSON manifest with SHA256 hashes. Redwood will push an encrypted bundle to a pre-authorized S3 bucket maintained by Octave and will retain a CRC/manifest copy on our side for 24 months. This meets the 24-month access ask for flagged forensic traces.
- Export schema: weekly bundles will be provided as CSV (primary) with a companion JSON manifest (schema documentation linked below).
- Retention & onramp timing: onramp will start Dec 1 (no changes during your Nov 15–22 launch). The 90-day capacity uplift (4 -> 12 vGPU-eq) is scheduled Dec 1–Feb 28.
- Commercials: we will set the 24-month term amendment; one-time 8% renewal credit applied to first invoice after amendment. The two dev-days for the manifest/encryption wrapper will be absorbed by Redwood (no pass-through charge).

Next actions:
1) I will have Legal circulate the SOW + one-page retention addendum by EOD Oct 28.
2) Procurement: please review acceptance criteria in the SOW draft — we include: timestamped hashes, three sample export files, and a checklist for auditor ingestion.
3) Signatures: once SOW & addendum are accepted we will route a DocuSign for the amendment (link below).

Reference links and docs: https://hubspot.com/deals/RWI-2026-3487, schema doc: https://drive.redwood.com/schemas/octave_evidence_schema_v1 (shared read-only), DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/rwi-octave-2026

If that all looks good, I can schedule the dry-run export for the week of Nov 30 (Dec 1 technical ramp).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence_manifest_for_octave_v1.pdf (pdf)
